Drawback: Emotional Swing.name: Drawback: Emotional Swing
Drawback: Emotional Swing.description:
🎭 Your Quirk follows your heart.

⚠️ Calm, it does what you ask. Rage, panic or grief make it surge past your aim; despair or self-doubt make it stall.
⚠️ The harder you have pushed, the less a strong feeling takes to tip it.
🎬 Similar canon Quirk: Eri (Rewind), which surges when she is frightened.
Drawback: Emotional Swing.traitNarrativeEffects: The Quirk follows the user's emotional state, and Quirk Strain sets how little it takes to tip it. Calm and focused: it lands exactly as aimed, with no spill. Strong rage, panic or grief make it surge past the aim; despair, shame or self-doubt make it stall or come out weak. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): a strong feeling tips it, and the moment shows which way. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; any feeling sharper than calm (irritation, worry, embarrassment) tips every use beyond light, and a surge can catch nearby people or property. Quirk Strain 100: the Quirk gives out until Strain falls below 60. Steadying (a breath, a friend's voice, a reason to keep going) brings control back on the next use. The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold. Ordinary life: the user knows their own tells and keeps calm on purpose, and friends learn what sets the Quirk off. If the character chose Quirkless, this drawback does not apply.
